description: Returns one section of the Dive Kit planning guide as markdown. Use this when you need to explain a term, a warning or deco theory, or to check what a planning conversation needs: workflow, tool chains, every input with unit, default and range (inputs_reference), deco theory, gradient factors, gas choice, gas planning, gas consumption, blending, weighting, CCR, bailout and contingencies, every warning, repetitive dives, worked examples, conventions, limits, sources; start_here is the index. Not for numbers: every figure comes from the planning tools.

topic.description: Guide section to return. Pick glossary for what a word means, deco_theory for how the model works, limits_and_safety for "is it safe". start_here: index of the guide and tools. workflow: how a planning conversation runs and what plan_dive needs. tool_chains: how one tool's result feeds the next, six recipes. inputs_reference: every input with unit, default and range. glossary: diver words, abbreviations and plan-table marks mapped to plain meaning and to fields. glossary_equipment: cylinders, rigs and every cylinders[].preset id with its size and fill. deco_theory: Bühlmann ZH-L16C and decompression basics. gradient_factors: what GF low/high do. gas_selection: choosing bottom and deco gases. gas_planning: gas volumes, reserves and turn pressure. gas_consumption: breathing rate (SAC, RMV), rmv_sac and gas_usage. gas_blending: plan_blend, mix_result and fill-station practice. blending_continuous_and_decant: blend_continuous and decant. buoyancy_and_weighting: buoyancy_check, weighting and failure cases. ccr: closed-circuit rebreather planning. bailout_and_contingencies: bailout and lost-gas plans. warnings: every warning and what it means. repetitive_dives: surface intervals and residual loading. worked_examples: complete example plans. why_plans_differ: why planners disagree. conventions: why Dive Kit numbers differ from textbook formulas. limits_and_safety: what this server does not do. sources: references.
